security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives from markdown code fences, inline paths, and skill names; no executable shell or Ruby code was found. The confirmed risk is that the skill requires parent-directory reference files and a mutable raw GitHub fallback, so important runtime instructions are outside the audited package. No prompt injection attempt was found in the scanned files.

remediation.issue: Required instructions are loaded from files outside the scanned skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the required runbook and CITE benchmark files inside the skill package, or remove mandatory parent-directory reads.

remediation.issue: The standalone fallback fetches mutable reference files from a GitHub main branch.
remediation.suggestion: Pin remote references to an immutable commit and verify file hashes before using them.

remediation.issue: Audit results may be saved into memory paths as part of the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before persisting reports or hot-cache entries that may contain sensitive domain findings.

content.user_title: Audit Domain Authority and Citation Trust
content.value_statement: Domain teams need a clear way to judge whether a site is credible enough to cite or optimize. This skill applies CITE scoring, veto checks, and prioritized fixes for domain authority work.
actual_capabilities: Scores domains across Citation, Identity, Trust, and Eminence dimensions.
Applies domain-type weights for content, product, commerce, community, tool, and institutional sites.
Checks trust veto items before giving a TRUSTED, CAUTIOUS, or UNTRUSTED verdict.
Produces per-item scoring, dimension totals, top priorities, and action plans.
Supports competitor comparisons when comparison domains and evidence are provided.
Marks unavailable evidence as N/A and names the missing data source.
limitations: Requires user-provided data when SEO, link, citation, or knowledge graph tools are unavailable.
Does not replace page-level content quality analysis.
Does not perform a complete backlink investigation by itself.
Scores depend on the quality and freshness of the evidence supplied.

use_cases.title: Pre-Campaign Authority Check
use_cases.description: Evaluate whether a domain has enough trust signals before starting a GEO or SEO campaign.

use_cases.title: Citation Source Review
use_cases.description: Decide whether a domain is credible enough to use as a citation source.

use_cases.title: Competitor Trust Benchmark
use_cases.description: Compare a client domain against competitors and identify the highest-impact authority gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Domain Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit domain authority for example.com. Use available evidence and mark missing data as N/A.

prompt_templates.title: Domain-Type Scoring
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with a known business type.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a CITE audit for example.com as an e-commerce site. Include weighted scores and trust veto checks.

prompt_templates.title: Competitor Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare domain authority for example.com, competitor-one.com, and competitor-two.com. Rank the top trust gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Full Evidence Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit example.com using this backlink export, traffic summary, brand search notes, and AI citation evidence. Explain all N/A items.

output_examples.input: Audit example.com as a SaaS domain.
output: Verdict: CAUTIOUS because trust signals are mixed but no veto issue is confirmed.
CITE score: 68 out of 100 after SaaS domain-type weighting.
Top priority: strengthen authoritative citations and improve branded search control.

output_examples.input: Compare my domain with two competitors.
output: The client domain trails both competitors in Citation and Eminence signals.
The strongest gap is high-quality referring domains from recognized industry publishers.
Recommended next step: prioritize digital PR and citation-quality improvements before broader GEO work.

output_examples.input: Can this domain be trusted as a citation source?
output: Verdict: TRUSTED when ownership, penalty history, citation quality, and brand evidence all pass review.
The report includes evidence notes and any unavailable checks that require manual confirmation.

best_practices: Provide backlink, traffic, brand search, and citation evidence before scoring.
Confirm the domain type before applying weighted CITE scores.
Review veto checks first because they can cap or block the final result.
anti_patterns: Do not treat missing AI citation data as an automatic failure.
Do not use this skill as the only source for page-level content quality decisions.
Do not compare domains without normalizing for domain type and available evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits domain-level authority, citation credibility, trust signals, and eminence using the CITE framework.

faq.question: Does it need external SEO tools?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user-provided evidence, but connected tools improve coverage and confidence.

faq.question: Can it audit individual pages?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on the domain behind the pages. Use a content quality skill for page-level review.

faq.question: What are trust veto checks?
faq.answer: They are critical signals such as link manipulation, shared backlink patterns, and penalty history.

faq.question: Can it compare competitors?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide comparison domains and available evidence so it can score gaps consistently.

faq.question: What result should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect a trust verdict, weighted CITE score, per-dimension notes, priority fixes, and a short handoff summary.
